h1: Lead source reports: what is worth your time
overview: More leads are not always better. We take your lead list and, where you can share them, outcomes, then work out which sources bring people who actually reply, book and buy, and what each source costs you. The report compares search, ads, social, referrals and email in plain words, and says where to put more effort and where to stop. It uses only your own data.

faq: Do you need tracking in place already?
Yes, source information has to exist in your leads. If it does not, our lead tracking service sets it up first, and then this report becomes far more useful.
What data do you need from me?
An export of your leads with dates and, if you have them, source and outcome. A CRM export or a spreadsheet works. We handle your data privately and delete our copy after delivery if you ask.
Can the report include my ad spend?
Yes. Give us spend per channel for the period, or view access to your ad accounts, and we calculate cost per lead and per won lead.
Will you tell me to stop a source?
Only when the numbers support it. We explain the evidence and the size of the sample, and we say plainly when there is too little data to decide.
